text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide and I go to see the Satsuki Sho together, and she keeps her eyes silently glued to Narita Brian the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Narita Brian wins the race with a record breaking time, Biwa Hayahide boldly declares that she will beat her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, I get word that the venue for the spring Tenno Sho is being changed to the Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite this, Biwa Hayahide is unfazed by the prospect of having to rebuild our strategy. That's when I realize how much she's grown.
